title: Vessel register and aliases
text:
Section D01 (Vessel register and aliases):
In this exercise register, the vessel with stable identifier SYN-V001 is named Atlas Kestrel. It was renamed from Northline Kestrel on October 15, 2026; the stable identifier SYN-V001 did not change. Southern Kestrel, SYN-V004, is a different vessel and is not an alias of SYN-V001. Amber Shoal is SYN-V002 and Lantern Tern is SYN-V003. All identifiers are fictional exercise identifiers, not IMO numbers or MMSI numbers.

title: Vessel operators
text:
Section D02 (Vessel operators):
Meridian Shelf Shipping, SYN-O01, operates Atlas Kestrel (SYN-V001) and Amber Shoal (SYN-V002). Bluewater Reach Logistics, SYN-O02, operates Lantern Tern (SYN-V003). Copper Bay Carriers, SYN-O03, operates Southern Kestrel (SYN-V004). These operator assignments apply throughout November 2026. They record operation of the vessels, not ownership of them.

title: Corporate group
text:
Section D03 (Corporate group):
Halcyon Maritime Group, SYN-G01, is the parent of Meridian Shelf Shipping (SYN-O01) and of Bluewater Reach Logistics (SYN-O02) throughout 2026. Copper Bay Carriers (SYN-O03) is independent in this fictional register and has no parent company recorded. A corporate parent relationship does not make the parent the operator or the owner of the vessels its subsidiaries operate.

title: Planned vessel calls
text:
Section D04 (Planned vessel calls):
The exercise register lists five planned vessel calls. SYN-C101: Atlas Kestrel (SYN-V001) at Berth B4 (SYN-B04) on November 18, 2026, planned 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. SYN-C102: Amber Shoal (SYN-V002) at Berth B2 (SYN-B02) on November 18, 2026, planned 13:00 to 19:00 UTC. SYN-C103: Lantern Tern (SYN-V003) at Berth B4 (SYN-B04) on November 18, 2026, planned 11:00 to 16:00 UTC. SYN-C104: Southern Kestrel (SYN-V004) at Berth W1 in Port Westhaven on November 18, 2026, planned 10:00 to 15:00 UTC. SYN-C105: Atlas Kestrel (SYN-V001) at Berth B4 (SYN-B04) on November 19, 2026, planned 09:00 to 12:00 UTC. All five are planned occupancies. Later explicit corrections supersede the named fields of a call only. No completed arrivals are recorded in this register.

title: Locations
text:
Section D05 (Locations):
Berth B4, SYN-B04, is in the East Basin of Port Lumen. Berth B2, SYN-B02, is in the West Basin of Port Lumen. Berth W1 is in Port Westhaven. Aster Terminal A1 is in Port Aster. Waypoint Cedar is an approach waypoint recorded for exercise navigation references; it is not a berth.

title: Berth B4 closure notice
text:
Section D06 (Berth B4 closure notice):
Notice SYN-N017 closes Berth B4 (SYN-B04) in Port Lumen for fender maintenance on November 18, 2026, from 08:00 to 20:00 UTC. The closure end time is exclusive. Berth B2 (SYN-B02) is unaffected. The notice closes the berth, not the whole port. No extension of this closure is recorded in this exercise register as of the cutoff.

title: Shipment assignments per call
text:
Section D07 (Shipment assignments per call):
Issued 2026-11-16T11:15:00Z D07 Shipment assignments per call Planned call SYN-C101 carries shipment SYN-S101, twelve refrigeration-module crates, for Pelagic Clinic Supply. Planned call SYN-C102 carries shipment SYN-S102, thirty packaging-material pallets, for Lumen Packaging Services. Planned call SYN-C103 carries shipment SYN-S103, eight water-treatment pump kits, for Island Utilities Cooperative. Shipment identifiers carry the full SYN- prefix throughout this register. No proof of delivery is recorded for any of these shipments.

title: Terminal capability
text:
Section D08 (Terminal capability):
Aster Terminal A1 in Port Aster can handle up to twenty refrigeration-module crates per booking and offers covered storage. Recorded capability is not a reservation, not an available slot, not a transit-time estimate, and not an authorization to handle cargo.

title: Schedule correction for SYN-C103
text:
Section D09 (Schedule correction for SYN-C103):
Issued 2026-11-17T09:00:00Z D09 Schedule correction for SYN-C103 Correction SYN-U09 explicitly replaces the planned times of call SYN-C103 for November 18, 2026. The new Berth B4 window is 21:00 to 23:00 UTC, replacing the previously planned 11:00 to 16:00 UTC. The vessel, the berth, and all other calls remain unchanged. The corrected window is still a planned occupancy, not an arrival.

title: Position reports
text:
Section D10 (Position reports):
At November 17, 10:00 UTC, report SYN-AIS01 recorded the vessel with identifier SYN-V001 under the old name Northline Kestrel at Waypoint Cedar. At 10:05 UTC the same day, report SYN-AIS02 recorded SYN-V004, Southern Kestrel, approaching Port Westhaven. No real coordinates and no berth arrivals are recorded in these exercise reports. A position report that uses a former vessel name does not describe a different vessel.

title: Handling proposal
text:
Section D11 (Handling proposal):
Request SYN-RQ11 proposes handling shipment SYN-S101 at Aster Terminal A1 on November 18, 2026. As of the exercise cutoff, terminal-slot confirmation and landside transport approval for this request remain pending. No diversion of any vessel has been approved and no completed cargo transfer is recorded.

title: Receiving assignments
text:
Section D12 (Receiving assignments):
Pelagic Clinic Supply assigns shipment SYN-S101 to Pearl Cold Store, with receipt requested by November 19, 2026 at 12:00 UTC. Island Utilities Cooperative assigns shipment SYN-S103 to Juniper Water Works by November 20, 2026 at 12:00 UTC. No actual delivery, transit-time estimate, or missed deadline is established by these receiving assignments.
